	PickUpFunction:InvokeServer(grapple.CurrentObject,true)
end

function PickupClass.CreateAttachment()
	if PickupClass.pickpart and not PickupClass.pickpart:FindFirstChild("Attachment") then
		local Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment",PickupClass.pickpart)
		return Attachment
	elseif PickupClass.pickpart and PickupClass.pickpart:FindFirstChild("Attachment") then
		return PickupClass.pickpart:FindFirstChild("Attachment")
	end
end

	if PickupClass.pickpart and not PickupClass.pickpart:FindFirstChild("Beam") then
		local Beam = Instance.new("Beam",PickupClass.pickpart)
		
		Beam.Width1 = 0.1
		Beam.Width0 = 0.1
		Beam.CurveSize1 = -10
		Beam.FaceCamera = true
		Beam.Color = ColorSequence.new{
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.new(0.235294, 1, 0)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.new(0.235294, 1, 0))
		}
		Beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new{
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)
		}
		return Beam
	elseif PickupClass.pickpart and PickupClass.pickpart:FindFirstChild("Beam") then
		return PickupClass.pickpart:FindFirstChild("Beam")
	end
end

	local BP = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
	BP.Parent = PickupClass.pickpart

	BP.P = 10500000
	BP.D = 15000

	return BP

"},{"id":484,"text":"local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local MobileTouchImmersionHelper = {}

local activeOwners = {}
local trackedInstances = {}
local watchConnections = {}
local playerGuiConnections = {}
local watchedPlayerGui: PlayerGui? = nil
local refreshQueued = false
local cachedPlayerModuleScript: ModuleScript? = nil
local cachedPlayerModule = nil
local cachedControls = nil
local controlsSuppressedByHelper = false
local TOUCH_IMMERSION_ENABLED = false

local function hasActiveOwners(): boolean
	return next(activeOwners) ~= nil
end

local function disconnectConnections(connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
	for index = #connections, 1, -1 do
		local connection = connections[index]
		connections[index] = nil
		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end
end

local function getLocalPlayer(): Player?
	if not RunService:IsClient() then
		return nil
	end
	return Players.LocalPlayer
end

local function getPlayerGui(): PlayerGui?
	local localPlayer = getLocalPlayer()
	if not localPlayer then return nil end
	return localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
end

local function safeSet(instance:Instance, propertyName:string, value:any)
	local ok, currentValue = pcall(function()
		return instance[propertyName]
	end)
	if not ok or currentValue == value then return end
	pcall(function()
		instance[propertyName] = value
	end)
end

local function invalidateControlsCache()
	cachedControls = nil
end

local function shouldSuppressTouchControls(): boolean
	return UserInputService.TouchEnabled
end

local function getPlayerControls()
	local localPlayer = getLocalPlayer()
	if not localPlayer then return cachedControls end
	local playerScripts = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
	if not playerScripts then return cachedControls end
	local playerModule = playerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
	if not playerModule or not playerModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then return cachedControls end
	if cachedPlayerModuleScript ~= playerModule or cachedPlayerModule == nil then
		local ok, moduleResult = pcall(require, playerModule)
		if not ok then return cachedControls end
		cachedPlayerModuleScript = playerModule
		cachedPlayerModule = moduleResult
		cachedControls = nil
	end
	if cachedControls ~= nil then return cachedControls end
	local ok, controls = pcall(function()
		if type(cachedPlayerModule) == "table" and type(cachedPlayerModule.GetControls) == "function" then
			return cachedPlayerModule:GetControls()
		end
		return nil
	end)
	if not ok then return nil end
	cachedControls = controls
	return cachedControls
end

local function suppressTouchControls()
	if not hasActiveOwners() or controlsSuppressedByHelper or not shouldSuppressTouchControls() then return end
	local controls = getPlayerControls()
	if not controls or type(controls.Disable) ~= "function" then return end
	local ok = pcall(function() controls:Disable() end)
	if ok then controlsSuppressedByHelper = true end
end

local function restoreTouchControls()
	if not controlsSuppressedByHelper then return end
	local controls = getPlayerControls()
	if not controls or type(controls.Enable) ~= "function" then
		controlsSuppressedByHelper = false
		return
	end
	pcall(function() controls:Enable() end)
	controlsSuppressedByHelper = false
end

local function ensureTrackedProperty(instance:Instance, propertyName:string, hiddenValue:any)
	local state = trackedInstances[instance]
	if not state then
		state = { originalValues = {}, observedProps = {}, connections = {} }
		trackedInstances[instance] = state
	end
	if state.observedProps[propertyName] ~= nil then
		safeSet(instance, propertyName, hiddenValue)
		return
	end
	local ok, currentValue = pcall(function() return instance[propertyName] end)
	if not ok then return end
	state.originalValues[propertyName] = currentValue
	state.observedProps[propertyName] = hiddenValue
	state.connections[#state.connections + 1] = instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal(propertyName):Connect(function()
		if hasActiveOwners() then safeSet(instance, propertyName, hiddenValue) end
	end)
	safeSet(instance, propertyName, hiddenValue)
end

local function hideInstanceAppearance(instance:Instance)
	if instance:IsA("GuiObject") then
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "Visible", false)
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "Interactable", false)
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "Active", false)
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "BackgroundTransparency", 1)
	end
	if instance:IsA("ImageLabel") or instance:IsA("ImageButton") then
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "ImageTransparency", 1)
	end
	if instance:IsA("TextLabel") or instance:IsA("TextButton") or instance:IsA("TextBox") then
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "TextTransparency", 1)
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "TextStrokeTransparency", 1)
	end
	if instance:IsA("UIStroke") then
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "Transparency", 1)
	end
end

local function hideSubtree(root:Instance)
	hideInstanceAppearance(root)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		hideInstanceAppearance(descendant)
	end
end

local function collectTargetRoots(): {Instance}
	local roots = {}
	local touchControlFrame: Instance? = nil
	local playerGui = getPlayerGui()
	if playerGui then
		local touchGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
		if touchGui then
			touchControlFrame = touchGui:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
			if touchControlFrame then
				roots[#roots + 1] = touchControlFrame
			end
		end
	end
	local shouldUseFallback = GuiService.TouchControlsEnabled or touchControlFrame ~= nil
	if shouldUseFallback then
		pcall(function()
			local robloxGui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui")
			local controlFrame = robloxGui and robloxGui:FindFirstChild("ControlFrame")
			if controlFrame then
				local bottomLeftControl = controlFrame:FindFirstChild("BottomLeftControl")
				local bottomRightControl = controlFrame:FindFirstChild("BottomRightControl")
				if bottomLeftControl then roots[#roots + 1] = bottomLeftControl end
				if bottomRightControl then roots[#roots + 1] = bottomRightControl end
			end
		end)
	end
	return roots
end

local function restoreTrackedInstances()
	for instance, state in pairs(trackedInstances) do
		for propertyName, originalValue in pairs(state.originalValues) do
			pcall(function() instance[propertyName] = originalValue end)
		end
		disconnectConnections(state.connections)
		trackedInstances[instance] = nil
	end
end

local function queueRefresh()
	if not hasActiveOwners() or refreshQueued then return end
	refreshQueued = true
	task.defer(function()
		refreshQueued = false
		if not hasActiveOwners() then return end
		suppressTouchControls()
		for _, root in ipairs(collectTargetRoots()) do
			hideSubtree(root)
		end
	end)
end

local function bindPlayerGuiConnections(playerGui: PlayerGui?)
	if watchedPlayerGui == playerGui then return end
	disconnectConnections(playerGuiConnections)
	watchedPlayerGui = playerGui
	if not playerGui then return end
	playerGuiConnections[#playerGuiConnections + 1] = playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(queueRefresh)
	playerGuiConnections[#playerGuiConnections + 1] = playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(queueRefresh)
end

local function startWatching()
	if #watchConnections > 0 then return end
	local localPlayer = getLocalPlayer()
	if not localPlayer then return end
	bindPlayerGuiConnections(getPlayerGui())
	watchConnections[#watchConnections + 1] = localPlayer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("PlayerGui") then
			bindPlayerGuiConnections(child)
			queueRefresh()
		end
	end)
	watchConnections[#watchConnections + 1] = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.defer(function()
			invalidateControlsCache()
			bindPlayerGuiConnections(getPlayerGui())
			suppressTouchControls()
			queueRefresh()
		end)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		watchConnections[#watchConnections + 1] = CoreGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(queueRefresh)
	end)
	watchConnections[#watchConnections + 1] = GuiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TouchControlsEnabled"):Connect(queueRefresh)
	queueRefresh()
end

local function stopWatching()
	refreshQueued = false
	disconnectConnections(watchConnections)
	disconnectConnections(playerGuiConnections)
	watchedPlayerGui = nil
end

function MobileTouchImmersionHelper:SetHidden(ownerKey:string, hidden:boolean)
	if type(ownerKey) ~= "string" or ownerKey == "" then
		warn("[MobileTouchImmersionHelper] ownerKey is required")
		return
	end
	if not RunService:IsClient() then return end
	if not TOUCH_IMMERSION_ENABLED then
		if hasActiveOwners() or next(trackedInstances) ~= nil or controlsSuppressedByHelper then
			MobileTouchImmersionHelper:ForceRestore()
		end
		return
	end
	local hadOwners = hasActiveOwners()
	if hidden then
		activeOwners[ownerKey] = true
	else
		activeOwners[ownerKey] = nil
	end
	local hasOwnersNow = hasActiveOwners()
	if hasOwnersNow and not hadOwners then
		startWatching()
		suppressTouchControls()
	elseif hadOwners and not hasOwnersNow then
		stopWatching()
		restoreTrackedInstances()
		restoreTouchControls()
		return
	end
	if hasOwnersNow then
		suppressTouchControls()
		queueRefresh()
	end
end

function MobileTouchImmersionHelper:ForceRestore()
	if not RunService:IsClient() then return end
	table.clear(activeOwners)
	stopWatching()
	restoreTrackedInstances()
	restoreTouchControls()
end

return MobileTouchImmersionHelper

function onPlayerVoChanged(playerVo:CommonType.PlayerVo)
    if DataHelper:IsInit() then
        DataHelper:InitPlayerVo(nil,playerVo)
    else
        DataHelper:SetPlayerVo(nil,playerVo)
    end
end

function onItemChanged(changedVos:{CommonType.ItemChangedVo},source:number,param:any)
    if not DataHelper:IsInit() then return end

    for _,vo in ipairs(changedVos) do
        if vo.itemType == CommonEnum.ItemType.Item then
            if vo.changeType == CommonEnum.ChangeType.add then
                DataHelper:AddItem(nil,vo.id,vo.amount)
                if vo.id == CommonEnum.ItemId.Gem then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        for i=1,vo.amount do
                            GameHelper:PlayAddGem(param)
                            task.wait(0.2)
                        end
                    end)
                elseif vo.id == CommonEnum.ItemId.Candy then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        for i=1,vo.amount do
                            GameHelper:PlayAddCandy(param)
                            task.wait(0.2)
                        end
                    end)
                elseif vo.id == CommonEnum.ItemId.Turkey then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        for i=1,vo.amount do
                            GameHelper:PlayAddTurkey(param)
                            task.wait(0.2)
                        end
                    end)
                elseif vo.id == CommonEnum.ItemId.GingerBread then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        for i=1,vo.amount do
                            GameHelper:PlayAddItemReward("gingerBread",param)
                            task.wait(0.2)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            elseif vo.changeType == CommonEnum.ChangeType.cost then
                DataHelper:CostItem(nil,vo.id,vo.amount)
            elseif vo.changeType == CommonEnum.ChangeType.cover then
                DataHelper:SetItem(nil,vo.id,vo.amount)
            end
        end
    end
end

function onStatsChanged(name:string,num:number)
    if not DataHelper:IsInit() then return end

    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo()
    if not playerVo or not playerVo.statsDict then return end

    playerVo.statsDict[name] = num
    DataHelper.onStatsChanged:Fire(game.Players.LocalPlayer,name)
end

DataHelper.OnPlayerVoChangedS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(onPlayerVoChanged)
DataHelper.OnItemChangedS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(onItemChanged)
DataHelper.OnStatsChangedS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(onStatsChanged)
GameHelper.FelledTreeS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function() end)"},{"id":486,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local _speed = 0.1
local _offset = Vector3.yAxis * 0.5
function onTagAdded(tree:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local t = 0
    local originCFrame = tree:GetPivot()
    table.insert(connections,tree:GetAttributeChangedSignal("hp"):Connect(function()
        local hp = tree:GetAttribute("hp")
        if hp > 0 then
            -- 跳一下
            t = _speed
        else
            t = 0
            tree:PivotTo(originCFrame)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt:number)
        if t <= 0 then return end

        t -= dt
        if t < 0 then t = 0 end
        local scale = t / _speed
        local rate = math.sin(scale * math.pi)
        tree:PivotTo(originCFrame - _offset * rate)
    end))
end

end

local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))

local newMeleeSwitch = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版近战判定")

local Sounds = {{124486113707811, "Metal"}, {87145893841801, "Metal"}, {8801553434, "Wood"}, {8801554545, "Wood"}}

function onTagAdded(axe: Tool, connections: {RBXScriptConnection})
    local woodSounds = {}
    for _, soundInfo in ipairs(Sounds) do
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.SoundId = "http://www.roblox.com/Asset/?id=" .. soundInfo[1]
        sound.Parent = axe
        sound.Volume = 1
        if soundInfo[2] == "Wood" then
            table.insert(woodSounds, sound)
        end
    end

    table.insert(connections, axe.Activated:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.2)

        local character: Model = axe.Parent
        if character ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then return end
        local humanoidRootPart: Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoidRootPart then return end

        local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
        overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Tree))
        if axe:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.PowerAxe) then
            overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree))
        end
        overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

        local radius = GameHelper.SwordAtkDistance
        local v_range: NumberValue = axe:FindFirstChild("Range")
        -- Known axe prefabs carry the synchronized Range value. Only resolve
        -- the shared profile for tools that lack the legacy fallback.
        local meleeProfile = if v_range then nil else MeleeWeaponSetting.GetByTool(axe)
        if v_range then
            radius = v_range.Value
        elseif meleeProfile and meleeProfile.reach then
            radius = meleeProfile.reach
        end

        local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(humanoidRootPart.Position, radius, overlapParams)
        local hitModels = {}
        local hitSound
        for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
            local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
            if not model or table.find(hitModels, model) then continue end
            table.insert(hitModels, model)
            hitSound = woodSounds[math.random(1, #woodSounds)]
            if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then
                GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S:FireServer(model)
            end
        end

        if hitSound and not hitSound.Playing then
            hitSound:Play()
        end
    end))
end

GameHelper.KilledByBossS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(boss:Model)
    if boss:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Deer) then
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("被Boss击杀")
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        local originCameraSubject = camera.CameraSubject

        local deerModel = GameHelper:GetDeerModel()
        local faceAtt:Attachment = deerModel:FindFirstChild("Head"):FindFirstChild("FaceFrontAttachment")

        local cd = 5
        local lerpAlpha = 0
        while cd > 0 do
            local dt = task.wait()
            if not originCameraSubject:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then break end
            if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then break end
            lerpAlpha += dt
            cd -= dt
            local cframe = faceAtt.WorldCFrame
            local targetCframe = CFrame.new(cframe.Position + cframe.LookVector * 3,cframe.Position)
            local curCframe = camera.CFrame
            camera.CFrame = curCframe:Lerp(targetCframe,math.clamp(lerpAlpha,0,1))
        end

        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        if not originCameraSubject or not originCameraSubject:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            camera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        end
    end
end)

GameHelper.BlockBulletS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(character:Model,enemy:Model,bulletPrefab:BasePart)
    -- task.wait(0.2)
    if not character then return end
    if not enemy then return end
    if not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end

    local endCframe = targetRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(-1 + math.random() * 2,0,-1 + math.random() * 2)

    local bullet:Part = bulletPrefab:Clone()

        CFrame = bullet.CFrame.Rotation + targetCFrame.Position
    })
    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        bullet.Anchored = false

        EffectHelper:AddItem(bullet,0,true)

end)"},{"id":491,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))

local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local EnemyHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EnemyHelper"))
local EffectHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EffectHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))

local EnemyValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.EnemyValue
local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local bulletTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)

function onTagAdded(enemy:Model, connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local v_targetPlayer:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(enemy,EnemyValue.targetPlayer)
    if v_targetPlayer then
        table.insert(connections,v_targetPlayer.Changed:Connect(function()
            if v_targetPlayer.Value == LocalPlayer then
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect("被敌人锁定")
            end
        end))
    end
end

function onEnemyGunAttack(enemy:Model,targetPlayer:Player,damage:number)
    local target:Model = targetPlayer.Character

    local id = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.id)
    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
    local bulletRanged = lo.attackDistance + 10

    local enemyRootPart:Part = enemy:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetRootPart:Part = target:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local startCFrame = enemyRootPart.CFrame
    
    local tool = enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
    if tool then
        local FirePoint:Attachment = tool:FindFirstChild("FirePoint")
        if FirePoint then
            startCFrame = startCFrame.Rotation + FirePoint.WorldPosition
        end
    end

    local offset = targetRootPart.Position - startCFrame.Position

    local bullet:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("Bullet"):Clone()
    bullet.Anchored = true
    bullet.Parent = workspace
    bullet.CFrame = startCFrame
    local targetCFrame:CFrame = startCFrame + offset.Unit * bulletRanged
    local tween = TweenService:Create(bullet,bulletTweenInfo,{
        CFrame = targetCFrame
    })
    tween:Play()
    -- tween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
    EffectHelper:AddItem(bullet,bulletTweenInfo.Time,true)

    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("敌人手枪射击", enemyRootPart, {
        TargetUserId = targetPlayer.UserId,
        SourceKey = enemy,
        FallbackPosition = enemyRootPart.Position,
    })

    local lastPos:Vector3 = nil
    -- 每个玩家只负责检测自己的碰撞
    while bullet:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) do
        if lastPos then
            -- print("检测")
            local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            raycastParams:AddToFilter({LocalPlayer.Character})
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            local offset = bullet.Position - lastPos
            local hitResult = workspace:Raycast(lastPos,offset.Unit * offset.Magnitude,raycastParams)
            if hitResult then
                if LocalPlayer.Character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BlockAttack) then
                    -- 反伤
                    GameHelper.BlockBulletC2S:FireServer(enemy,damage * 2)
                else
                    -- 承受伤害
                    GameHelper.CharacterTakeDamageC2S:FireServer(damage,enemy)
                end
                -- 命中自己后停止检测，避免重复命中
                break
            end
        end

        if tween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
            break
        end
        lastPos = bullet.Position
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end

function onEnemyPoisonedArrowAttack(enemy:Model,targetPlayer:Player,damage:number)
	local isLocalPlayer = targetPlayer == LocalPlayer

    local enemyRootPart:Part = enemy:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("射箭",enemyRootPart)

    local prefab = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("毒箭")
    local RightGripAttachment:Attachment = enemy:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment",true)
    local startPos = RightGripAttachment and RightGripAttachment.WorldCFrame.Position or enemy:GetPivot().Position
    local endPos:Vector3 = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head").Position
	local arrow = prefab:Clone()
	arrow.Position = startPos
	arrow.CanCollide = false
	arrow.CanQuery = false
	arrow.CanTouch = false
	arrow.Parent = workspace
	arrow.Transparency = 1
	arrow.Anchored = false
	game.Debris:AddItem(arrow,5)
    local offset = (endPos - startPos)
	arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = offset.Unit * 500
	local lastPos = arrow.Position

    local con:RBXScriptConnection
    con = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(time, deltaTime)
        if arrow and arrow:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
			raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
			raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

			local offset = (arrow.Position - lastPos)
			local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(lastPos,offset.Unit * offset.Magnitude,raycastParams)
			if hitResult then
				local hit = hitResult.Instance
				if isLocalPlayer and hitResult.Instance:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character) then
                    if LocalPlayer.Character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BlockAttack) then
                        -- 反伤
                        GameHelper.BlockBulletC2S:FireServer(enemy,damage * 2,prefab)
                    else
                        -- 击中自己
					    GameHelper.CharacterTakeDamageC2S:FireServer(damage,enemy)
                    end
				end
				arrow:WaitForChild("Trail").Enabled = false
				local dir = arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit
				arrow.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitResult.Position,hitResult.Position+dir)
				arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				arrow.Transparency = 0
				arrow.Parent = hit
				CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(arrow,hit)

                con:Disconnect()
                return
			end
			lastPos = arrow.Position
        else
            con:Disconnect()
        end
    end)
end

function onEnemyArrowAttack(enemy:Model,targetPlayer:Player,damage:number)
	local isLocalPlayer = targetPlayer == LocalPlayer

    local enemyRootPart:Part = enemy:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("射箭",enemyRootPart)

    local prefab = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("箭")

    local startPos = RightGripAttachment and RightGripAttachment.WorldCFrame.Position or enemy:GetPivot().Position
    local endPos:Vector3 = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head").Position
	local arrow = prefab:Clone()
	arrow.Position = startPos
	arrow.CanCollide = false
	arrow.CanQuery = false
	arrow.CanTouch = false
	arrow.Parent = workspace
	arrow.Transparency = 1
	arrow.Anchored = false
	game.Debris:AddItem(arrow,5)
    local offset = (endPos - startPos)
	arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = offset.Unit * 500
	local lastPos = arrow.Position

    local con:RBXScriptConnection
    con = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(time, deltaTime)
        if arrow and arrow:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
			raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
			raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

			local offset = (arrow.Position - lastPos)
			local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(lastPos,offset.Unit * offset.Magnitude,raycastParams)
			if hitResult then
				local hit = hitResult.Instance
				if isLocalPlayer and hitResult.Instance:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character) then
                    if LocalPlayer.Character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BlockAttack) then
                        -- 反伤
                        GameHelper.BlockBulletC2S:FireServer(enemy,damage * 2,prefab)
                    else
                        -- 击中自己
					    GameHelper.CharacterTakeDamageC2S:FireServer(damage,enemy)
                    end
				end
				arrow:WaitForChild("Trail").Enabled = false
				local dir = arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit
				arrow.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitResult.Position,hitResult.Position+dir)
				arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				arrow.Transparency = 0
				arrow.Parent = hit
				CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(arrow,hit)

                con:Disconnect()
                return
			end
			lastPos = arrow.Position
        else
            con:Disconnect()
        end
    end)
end
